questions.question: In 1851, who founded the science of hydrodynamics with his law of viscosity describing the velocity of a small sphere through a viscous fluid?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**George Gabriel Stokes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hydrodynamics:-**

 
 
• It is the study of fluids in motion, including liquids and gases.
 
 
 
• **George Gabriel Stokes:-**
 
 
• He was an Irish mathematician and physicist who made significant contributions to fluid dynamics and optics. 
 
• George Gabriel Stokes founded the science of hydrodynamics with his law of viscosity, which describes the relationship between the velocity of a small sphere and the viscosity of a fluid.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Daniel Bernoulli:-**

 
 
• He was a Swiss mathematician who is known for his work on fluid dynamics, including Bernoulli's principle.
 
 
 
• **Evangelista Torricelli:-**
 
 
• He was an Italian physicist and mathematician who is best known for inventing the barometer.
 
 
 
• **Heinrich Gustav Magnus:-**
 
 
• He was a German physicist who made important contributions to the study of magnetism and thermodynamics.

questions.question: The rate at which the Reserve Bank of India lends to other commercial banks for short term has been reduced. What is this rate called?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Repo Rate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Repo Rate:-**

 
 
• It is the rate at which the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) lends money to commercial banks for short term.
 
• The reduction in Repo Rate indicates that the RBI is trying to encourage borrowing and spending in the economy. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cash Reserve Rate:-**

 
 
• CRR is the amount of funds that banks have to keep with the RBI as a reserve. It is not related to lending rates.
 
 
 
• **Reverse Repo Rate:-**
 
 
• It is the rate at which the RBI borrows money from commercial banks. It is also not related to lending rates.
 
 
 
• **Bank Rate:-**
 
 
• It is the rate at which the RBI lends money to commercial banks for long term. It is also not related to short-term lending rates.

questions.question: Which of these statements is true?

options.text: Under competitive asset market conditions, the price of a bond must always be equal to its present value in equilibrium.

Under competitive asset market conditions, the price of a bond must exceed its present value to benefit the buyer.

questions.solution: The correct answer is __**Under competitive asset market conditions, the price of a bond must always be equal to its present value in equilibrium.**__

questions.question: Which of these is NOT one of the negative effects of the green revolution?

options.text: Primarily medium and large farmers were able to benefit from the new technology of the green revolution.
The green revolution benefited farmers who had access to land, capital, technology and know-how.
The green revolution led to the displacement of tenant cultivators in many cases.
The green revolution caused increased migration from urban to rural areas.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**green revolution caused increased migration from urban to rural areas.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Green revolution:-**

 
 
• **The green revolution was a period of technological advancement in agriculture that began in the 1940s and continued until the 1970s.**
 
• **The green revolution was mainly focused on increasing the productivity of high-yielding crops such as wheat, rice, and maize.**
 
• **The green revolution was successful in increasing crop yields and reducing food insecurity in many parts of the world, particularly in Asia and Latin America.**
 
• Primarily medium and large farmers were able to benefit from the new technology of the green revolution. This statement is true as the green revolution was mainly focused on increasing the productivity of high-yielding crops, which required a certain level of investment and resources that small farmers could not afford.
 
• The green revolution benefited farmers who had access to land, capital, technology, and know-how. This statement is also true as the green revolution required a certain level of resources and infrastructure to be successful, and farmers who had access to these resources were able to benefit from it.
 
• The green revolution led to the displacement of tenant cultivators in many cases. This statement is also true as the green revolution led to the consolidation of landholdings and the displacement of small farmers and tenant cultivators who could not compete with the larger farmers.

questions.question: When milk is converted into curd, which type of change is it?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chemical Change.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chemical change:-**

 
 
• This type of change alters the composition of the substance and results in the formation of a new substance. Examples include combustion, rusting, and digestion. When milk is converted into curd, it undergoes a chemical change.
 
• This change is irreversible, meaning it cannot be undone.
 
• The process of converting milk into curd is called fermentation, which is a chemical reaction that occurs due to the presence of bacteria.
 
• During fermentation, the lactose in the milk is converted into lactic acid, which causes the milk to thicken and form curd.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reversible change: **

 
 
• This type of change can be undone, meaning the original substance can be restored. Examples include melting and freezing of ice.
 
 
 
• **Physical change: **
 
 
• This type of change does not alter the composition of the substance. Examples include changes in state (solid, liquid, gas) and changes in shape or size.
 
 
 
• **Isothermal change: **
 
 
• This type of change occurs at a constant temperature and does not involve any change in energy.

questions.question: Which of the following is a liberal principle of the Directive Principles of State Policy of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To secure uniform civil code**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Liberal principle:-**

 
 
• The liberal principle of the Directive Principles of State Policy of the Indian Constitution is to secure uniform civil code.
 
• This means that the state should strive to have a common set of laws governing personal matters such as marriage, divorce, inheritance, and adoption, regardless of the religion or community of the individuals involved. This is seen as a way to promote gender equality and social harmony. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy:-**

 
 
• The Directive Principles of State Policy are not enforceable by the courts, but are considered to be fundamental in the governance of the country. They are guidelines for the government to follow in making policies and laws.
 
• The issue of uniform civil code is a controversial one in India, with some arguing that it would infringe on the rights of religious minorities and others advocating for its implementation as a way to promote secularism and gender equality.
